quote: Everyone I know has a reason they almost left. A job offer in Toronto. A cousin in New Singapore. A transfer that fell through at the last Φ. Every single one of them is still here. Every single one of them has a different excuse. None of them tried twice.
context: The retention effect of the GLMZ operates through accumulated small failures. No single barrier is insurmountable, but the pattern of near-departures that never complete suggests a systemic mechanism that residents cannot perceive from inside.
